extension.description: A black-paged photo album of your life with films: every film you watched is a print with the date stamped in the corner in orange camera digits, and handwritten notes tell you what you were watching a year ago this week, what you stopped, and what has been waiting since you added it. Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v0.9.18 - Counts of one now read in the singular (1 season, 1 episode, 1 film, 1 album, 1 track, 1 result). Smaller download: removed images the skin never used. v0.9.17 - Empty pages no longer write over the Back item; long titles no longer show the top of a third line; dates read correctly in regions that write the month first (USA); the film info's genres and story no longer run into the clock or cut a line.
